high_level_description: The image showcases the ornate façade of Rouen Cathedral in France. The cathedral is a stunning example of Gothic architecture, characterized by its intricate stone carvings, pointed arches, and multiple spires. The central part of the façade features a large rose window surrounded by detailed sculptures and statues, which are typical elements of Gothic design. The text overlay provides historical context about the cathedral, noting that it was built in 1030 and underwent a Gothic rebuild starting in 1145.
